full_judgment:
Md. Tafazzul Islam, J:- In this application under Article 102 of the Constitution, the petitioner has challenged the judgment and order dated 15.6.03 passed by the Additional District Judge, 2nd Court Pabna by which Miscellaneous Case No. 12 of 2003 filed under section 52K of the Co-operative Societies Act 2001 was dismissed and the judgment and order dated 26.2.2003 passed by the respondent no. 3 i.e. Deputy Registrar (Bichar) in Appeal Case no. 1 of 2003 confirming the judgment and order dated 7.1.2003, was upheld. 

 2. Mr. M. A. Latif Prodhan, the learned Advocate appears for the petitioner submits that no appeal lies against the impugned order passed under section 52(ka) (ka) of Cooperative Societies Act 2001 and further in the instant case learned District Judge did not act as a court but as a persons designate and so writ lies against the impugned judgment and order in view of the principles as laid down in the case of Md. Lal Mia vs. Bangladesh Milk Producers Cooperative Union Ltd. and others reported in 17 BLD (AD) 293. 

 4. Further in the present case the District Judge did not act in his private capacity or any capacity other than a court and the jurisdiction he exercised means and refers to the jurisdiction lie exercised while sitting as a court. So, there is no doubt that in the present case the District Judge, functions as a court.
